Name: Flower Decal - AT
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]Adds 5 variations of a flower decal through Alternative Textures![/size]

[size=3]Placing the objects/paintings will randomly pick one of the textures, however, if you'd like to set a specific texture, you'd need to buy the Paint Bucket Tool (added by AT) at Robin's shop. To use the paint bucket, click on the object while equipping the bucket and pick the texture of your choice. For more information on this tool, check PeacefulEnd's wiki on it [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url]. [/size]

[size=4]THESE FLOWERS REPLACE THE [color=#6d9eeb][b]CLOUD DECALS.[/b][/color][/size]

[size=5]Installation: [/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url][size=3]2. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
[size=3]3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)[/size]
[size=3]4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder[/size]
[size=3]5. Launch your game and enjoy!  [/size]
